title: The Sublime, Sponsored by Ghost Planet
description: A monumental nineteenth-century American landscape painting: Yosemite cliffs rise into a vast violet storm and golden sunset, with an absurdly tiny Space Ghost giving a solemn guided tour to three unimpressed woodland animals on the foreground overlook. A little folding director's chair has been set down next to a majestic waterfall. Beautiful painterly detail and epic atmospheric depth.
prompt:
Create exactly one beautiful 16:10 landscape desktop wallpaper, preferably 2560x1600. It is an affectionate, funny Space Ghost parody in a painterly style with extraordinary detail: deep aubergine shadows, violet and lilac atmosphere, subtle magenta, moon-white cape highlights, warm antique gold accents. Space Ghost is the recognizable animated superhero: muscular, white costume, black hood/mask, yellow cape, red power bands. Make the visual joke readable and charming without explanatory text. Preserve a spacious, quieter upper edge for a desktop panel. No UI, words, logos, watermarks or picture frames. Deliver the actual raster image using built-in native image generation; do not substitute code, SVG or a text description.

Theme: Gruvbox Dark. Gruvbox Dark color direction: warm charcoal and soot-black shadows (#282828, #1d2021), aged cream and parchment (#ebdbb2), glowing amber (#fabd2f), burnt orange (#fe8019), muted olive (#b8bb26), and restrained blue-grey (#83a598). Rich painterly canvas texture, cinematic chiaroscuro, luminous focal detail against calm dark negative space. Match a sophisticated warm dark desktop. Let Space Ghost's white suit read as aged ivory. Keep the scene funny, beautifully composed and legible at desktop scale. Avoid dominant purple or neon pink.
